client.business_model: Multi-state women's health provider platform operating OB/GYN clinics, ancillary women-focused services and telehealth offerings.
client.sponsor_pe_firm: BlueMountain Capital Management (2020 investment); Deerfield Management Company (2016 growth financing)
client.client_history: Founded in 2014 in Arlington, Virginia, Advantia Health has grown through acquisitions such as the 2019 purchase of Heartland Women’s Healthcare (adding 25 sites) and the Pacify telehealth platform. Backed by healthcare investors BlueMountain and Deerfield, the company now offers integrated in-person and virtual care for women across several Mid-Atlantic and Midwest states.

revenue.notes: Reported figures vary widely: Zippia $13M, Buzzfile $29.1M, Growjo $22.4M, CanvasBusinessModel $89M (2024). No official filing found; using the mid-range Growjo estimate but reliability is low.

locations.source: Company locations list on AdvantiaHealth.com/locations (compiled in web search results)
locations.notes: Web search enumerated 27 specific addresses and references 25 Heartland Women’s Healthcare sites, implying roughly 50 total. No single authoritative count stated.

employees.source: LeadIQ profile (Dec 2025) and Indeed company page, both citing 501-1,000 employees; Buzzfile lists 259.
employees.notes: Multiple employment data sources; majority (LeadIQ, SignalHire, Indeed) cluster around ~500 while Buzzfile is lower. Adopted 500 midpoint with medium confidence.
